verdict.rationale: AutoGen's own docs list GraphFlow, which provides "multi-agent workflows through a directed graph of agents", so explicit graph composition is a first-party capability. The pack does not show the specific control-flow features the story asks for. Other team types (round-robin, selector, Swarm handoffs) are turn-taking patterns rather than explicit graph constructs. missing for 10: documented conditional branching, loop/cycle support, parallel (fan-out/fan-in) execution, hands-on corroboration of GraphFlow

support.subject: As a developer, I can compose agents into an explicit graph or workflow with branching, loops, and parallel steps
